climates.description: Frozen polar regions with ice caps and dust storms.

climates.description: Extreme desert with volcanic features and canyons.

ocean_world.description: Planet covered mostly in water with small islands. Ideal for water transport.

oasis_bonus.description: Oases provide bonus cargo and passenger generation
